connection_condition: cards.scryfallOracleId is shared by every printing of the same card
description: A card printing is an instance of a card: every attribute of a printing also characterises the card, while one card has many printings.
A printing belongs to exactly one card set; a printing cannot exist without the set that released it.
A legality verdict is a component record of one printing; without the printing the verdict is meaningless.
A localized card record is a language-specific component of one printing, carrying that printing's translated name, rules text and flavor text.
A localized set name is a component record of one set and depends on that set's existence.
An official ruling is a component record attached to one printing; it has no meaning without that printing.

connection_condition: sets.block groups set rows by a free-text label rather than by an identifier reference
description: A block groups several sets that belong to the same release cycle, but no structural identifier links them, so the connection is a weak semantic association.

connection_condition: both name forms attach to the same printing through uuid; cards.name holds the English form and foreign_data.name the localized form
description: The English card name and the localized card name express the same concept, so a name lookup in one form should lead to the other representation of the same card.

connection_condition: sets.name and set_translations.translation name the same set and are linked through the set code
description: An official or marketplace set name and a localized set name express the same concept and denote the same set.

connection_condition: foreign_data.language and set_translations.language draw on the same set of language labels, including 'Portuguese (Brazil)'
description: The language of a card's text and the language of a set's localized name share one value domain and one label vocabulary, even though they describe different objects and have very different coverage.
Converted mana cost is derived from mana cost as the total number of mana symbols in the cost, with absent costs treated as zero.
A percentage share is derived from a population of card printings as the count satisfying a stated condition divided by the count of the declared base population.
Every legality verdict is scoped to exactly one play format; the format is a categorical label of the verdict rather than a referenced entity.
Every legality verdict carries exactly one status value expressing the verdict on the card in that format.
